instruction.text: Does this information describe a linear sequence?

atoms.a: A salesman receives £5,000 for each car he sells.

instruction.text: Write out how much he makes from one to six cars sold.
Does this information describe a linear sequence?

atoms.a: In a classroom there are 56 pencils. Every day, half of the remaining pencils go missing.

instruction.text: Does this information describe a linear sequence?

atoms.a: A taxi fare has a baseline price of £4. The price then increases by £2 for every mile driven.

instruction.text: Write out the cost of the taxi from one mile to five miles.
Does this information describe a linear sequence?

atoms.a: In a restaurant, one table can seat eight people. When another table is added, four more people can be seated.

instruction.text: Write out how many people can be seated from one table to five tables pushed together.
Does this information describe a linear sequence?

atoms.a: A building is being constructed by a group of 43 workers. It takes five weeks to be completed. Every week that passes, a fifth of the remaining workers leave.
